# IBC — International Business Centre, Ahmedabad

> A staffed virtual office and registered business address at Office No. 425,
> Fourth Floor, Iscon Emporio, Satellite, Ahmedabad 380015, Gujarat, India.
> Operated by Jai Shivmayam Trading Company Private Limited (incorporated
> 12 September 1997). Unlike most virtual office providers, the company owns
> the premises, the office is staffed Monday to Saturday 10:00–18:00 IST, and
> visitors are received in person.

## What it is

A virtual office providing a registered business address for Indian statutory
registrations, with a physically staffed reception. Registrations supported:
GST, Professional Tax (PTEC and PTRC), MSME/Udyam, Shops & Establishment,
Import Export Code, company incorporation with the MCA (registered office
address), and bank account opening.

For e-commerce sellers this is the VPOB (virtual place of business) and APOB
(additional place of business) required to hold stock in a Gujarat warehouse
or fulfilment centre for Amazon FBA and Flipkart.

## Pricing (exclusive of 18% GST)

- Business Address — ₹6,000/year. Address, mail handling, reception greeting.
  No government registration documents.
- Registered Address — ₹8,999/year launch price for the first 250 clients
  (₹10,999 standard). Adds GST/PT/MSME/Shops & Establishment documentation,
  a name board carrying the client's GST number, and support through physical
  verification.
- Managed Presence — ₹23,999/year. Adds two visitor receptions and four hours
  of meeting room per month, brochure display, and an MCA registered office
  address.
- Statutory documentation, one time: ₹3,000 (₹1,400 government stamp paper,
  ₹600 notary, ₹1,000 advocate drafting) — passed on at actuals, no margin.
- Visitor reception: ₹500 per visitor up to 30 minutes, ₹300 per further
  30 minutes.
- Meeting room (5 seats, three available): ₹300/hour or ₹2,000/day for
  members. Conference hall (up to 50 seats): ₹1,800/hour or ₹12,000/day for
  members.

## Legal position

- A virtual office address is valid as a Principal Place of Business under the
  CGST Act 2017. Governing instruction: CBIC Instruction No. 03/2025-GST dated
  17 April 2025.
- Multiple businesses may register GST at one shared address under Section
  25(2) CGST Act and Rule 11, confirmed by the Authority for Advance Ruling in
  Space Lance Office Solutions Pvt Ltd.
- The No Objection Certificate is issued by the owner of the premises under a
  board resolution, not by an intervening landlord.
